E-INPUT-001.title: Empty input
E-INPUT-001.description: No descriptor or file was provided.
E-INPUT-001.action: Paste a descriptor or choose a file.

E-INPUT-002.title: Input too large
E-INPUT-002.description: The file exceeds the 10 MB limit.
E-INPUT-002.action: Trim the file or contact support if it should be smaller.

E-INPUT-003.title: Invalid file format
E-INPUT-003.description: The file's content does not match any known wallet export format.
E-INPUT-003.action: Confirm the file is a descriptor (.txt, .json) or supported wallet export.

E-PARSE-001.title: Descriptor cannot be parsed
E-PARSE-001.description: The text you provided is not a valid BIP380 descriptor.
E-PARSE-001.action: Confirm you copied the full descriptor including any leading `wsh(`/`wpkh(`. If you're unsure, see the per-wallet export instructions.

E-PARSE-002.title: Descriptor checksum missing
E-PARSE-002.description: BIP380 descriptors should include a `#xxxxxxxx` checksum.
E-PARSE-002.action: Add the checksum (Lifeboat can compute one) or re-export from your wallet.

E-PARSE-003.title: Descriptor checksum invalid
E-PARSE-003.description: The descriptor's checksum does not match its content. The descriptor may have been transcribed incorrectly.
E-PARSE-003.action: Re-export the descriptor from your wallet software.

E-PARSE-004.title: Descriptor mixes networks
E-PARSE-004.description: The descriptor contains keys from multiple Bitcoin networks (e.g., mainnet and testnet).
E-PARSE-004.action: This is almost always a mistake. Re-export the descriptor and verify it contains only mainnet keys (or only testnet, if intentional).

E-PARSE-005.title: Descriptor contains private keys
E-PARSE-005.description: The descriptor includes an extended private key (xprv/yprv/zprv/tprv/uprv/vprv) or a raw private key. Lifeboat refuses to process descriptors that contain secret material.
E-PARSE-005.action: Re-export the descriptor in watch-only form (xpub instead of xprv).

E-PARSE-006.title: Unsupported descriptor function
E-PARSE-006.description: The descriptor uses a function Lifeboat does not yet support in this version (e.g., raw(), addr()).
E-PARSE-006.action: Use a wallet that exports a supported descriptor (wpkh, wsh, sh(wpkh), multi, sortedmulti).

E-PARSE-007.title: Multisig threshold exceeds key count
E-PARSE-007.description: The descriptor specifies M-of-N where M > N, which can never be satisfied.
E-PARSE-007.action: Confirm the descriptor; this likely indicates a transcription error.

E-SECRET-001.title: BIP39 mnemonic detected
E-SECRET-001.description: The input contains a sequence of words matching a BIP39 wordlist with a valid checksum. Lifeboat does not accept seed phrases.
E-SECRET-001.action: Export the OUTPUT DESCRIPTOR (not the seed) from your wallet software and paste it instead.

E-SECRET-002.title: Possible BIP39 mnemonic detected
E-SECRET-002.description: The input contains a sequence of BIP39 words; the checksum did not validate but the pattern is suspicious.
E-SECRET-002.action: If you intended to paste a descriptor and this is a false positive, type "I confirm this is not a real seed" to proceed.

E-SECRET-003.title: Private key (WIF) detected
E-SECRET-003.description: The input matches the WIF private key format. Lifeboat does not accept private keys.
E-SECRET-003.action: Use the corresponding public key or xpub instead.

E-SECRET-004.title: Extended private key detected
E-SECRET-004.description: The input contains an xprv / yprv / zprv / tprv / uprv / vprv. Lifeboat does not accept extended private keys.
E-SECRET-004.action: Use the corresponding xpub / ypub / zpub / tpub / upub / vpub instead.

E-SECRET-005.title: SLIP-39 share detected
E-SECRET-005.description: The input appears to be a SLIP-39 Shamir backup share.
E-SECRET-005.action: Lifeboat does not need SLIP-39 shares. Use your wallet's output descriptor.

E-SECRET-006.title: codex32 secret detected
E-SECRET-006.description: The input appears to be a codex32 (BIP-93) secret.
E-SECRET-006.action: Lifeboat does not need codex32 secrets. Use your wallet's output descriptor.

E-SECRET-007.title: Possible raw private key detected
E-SECRET-007.description: The input contains a 64-character hex string in a suspicious context (e.g., adjacent to the word "private" or "key").
E-SECRET-007.action: Confirm this is not a private key. If you intended a transaction ID or block hash, it should not appear in this field.

E-FS-001.title: File not found
E-FS-001.description: The file path you provided does not exist or is not readable.
E-FS-001.action: Verify the path and permissions, then try again.

E-FS-002.title: Cannot write to destination
E-FS-002.description: The destination path is not writable.
E-FS-002.action: Choose a different destination or check permissions.

E-FS-003.title: Destination file exists
E-FS-003.description: A file already exists at the destination.
E-FS-003.action: Confirm overwrite or choose a different name.

E-NETWORK-001.title: Network unreachable
E-NETWORK-001.action: Verify your internet connection or try again later.

E-NETWORK-002.title: Unexpected network call attempted
E-NETWORK-002.description: Internal: A component attempted a network call without explicit user action.
E-NETWORK-002.action: This is a bug. Please file an issue at the GitHub repository.

E-DEP-001.title: Typst not bundled
E-DEP-001.description: PDF generation requires the bundled Typst binary, which was not found.
E-DEP-001.action: Reinstall Lifeboat. If the issue persists, file an issue.

E-DEP-002.title: HWI not available
E-DEP-002.description: Hardware wallet operations require the HWI sidecar binary (v0.4+), which was not found.
E-DEP-002.action: Reinstall the version of Lifeboat that includes HWI, or use file-based PSBT.

E-LINK-001.title: External link not allowed
E-LINK-001.description: The link is not in the project's allowlist of external URLs.
E-LINK-001.action: Verify the link manually in your browser if you trust it.

E-INTERNAL-001.title: Unexpected error
E-INTERNAL-001.action: Please file an issue at the GitHub repository with the reproduction steps.

E-INTERNAL-002.title: Schema migration required
E-INTERNAL-002.description: The settings file uses a format from an older version of Lifeboat.
E-INTERNAL-002.action: Lifeboat will attempt to migrate. If that fails, delete the settings file.
